comment: Curated Open Food Facts barcodes for the shipped catalog (plans/FOOD_WASTE_REALISM_PLAN.md Phase 2). tools/food/fetch_products.py downloads each into tools/food/cache/, then build_catalog.gd parses them with the game's own FoodProducts parser. A product entry may carry its own price_usd; otherwise tools/food/category_prices.json estimates it from the category and net weight.
